For items 1–10 listen to the introduction to a radio show about the American
entertainer, Liberace, and decide whether the statements (1–10) are TRUE, or FALSE
according to the text you hear. You will hear the text twice.
1. Liberace has been dominating world entertainment for four decades.
2. Liberace’s mother was born in Italy.
3. Liberace’s father occasionally made a living working at a factory.
4. Liberace’s mother considered playing music a useless pastime.
5. Liberace started playing piano at the age of eight.
6. Liberace started playing pop music after World War II.
7. Liberace wasn`t a modest person.
8. Liberace first appeared on the radio in 1952.
9. Liberace’s concerts were famous for a warm atmosphere.
10. Some people didn’t accept Liberace’s style and laughed at it.
